title: COBRA Frames: Contextual Reasoning about Effects and Harms of Offensive Statements
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark (COBRACORPUS) and a formalism (COBRA Frames) designed to evaluate and explain the offensiveness and harms of statements. By modeling intents, listener reactions, and the ethical implications of speech (such as microaggressions), the study evaluates models' abilities to make moral and social judgments.
